clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine, Deathstalker Erland needs help reaching his partner. Wolves have trapped him in a shelter, and he must cross their hunting ground to reach Rane Yorick.

Deathstalker Erland is trapped in a shelter by hungry wolves. Even seasoned Forsaken scouts can be outmatched by Silverpine's wilds. The wolves circle the ruined refuge, drawn to the little flesh left on Erland's withered frame. Alone, he cannot break through their pack.

Deathstalker Erland needs to reach his partner, Rane Yorick, near the Ivar Patch. The way crosses ground prowled by wolves. Once you guide him past them, Erland runs the last stretch to Rane Yorick's outpost. There, the scouts can bring their intelligence together for the Undercity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door. They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.
I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick. And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.
Please escort me! And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please be brief. There is much danger about and we cannot stand idle in conversation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for the aid, friend. I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. With your help, I see that he has not.
